newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania sends condolences to China. [CORRECTED 18:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Albania sends condolences to China. [CORRECTED 18:45 GMT]

text.p: Albanian President Sali Berisha sent his condolences to China on Thursday over the death of Deng Hsiao Ping.
"Death of Deng Hsiao Ping, father and architect of the market perestroika, of China's opening and modernisation, is a great loss for your great people and all their friends in the world.
"On this occasion I express to you, the Chinese friendly people and Deng Hsiao Ping's family my sincere condolensces," he said in a letter to President Jiang Zemin.

After breaking with the former Soviet Union in 1961, Albania became one of communist China's closest allies. But in 1978 (corrects year from 1968), late Albanian communist dictator Enver Hoxha moved away from China as well.
Communism fell in Albania in 1990. Berisha, right-wing and pro-free market, became the first freely president in 1992.
